nodes.title: SG-4.2 · No tracked changes in vendored Phaser files under node_modules
nodes.body:
Context: game/frontend/node_modules is committed (about 15k files, including node_modules/phaser/scripts/tsgen) and root .gitignore only ignores game/node_modules/, which is the wrong path. The git status also shows a conflicted tracked cache file game/frontend/node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json. Desired behavior: node_modules is ignored everywhere and no node_modules path is tracked, so vendored Phaser files cannot show as modified. Why: Act steps modified vendored tsgen files, which must never appear as product changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repository, when .gitignore is read, then it ignores node_modules at any depth, including game/frontend/node_modules
- Given the git index, when tracked paths are listed, then none contains a node_modules path segment


## Scope
- In scope: .gitignore ignore rules
- In scope: untracking node_modules from the index
- In scope: a guard helper that detects tracked node_modules paths
- Out of scope: Changing phaser version or its pin
- Out of scope: Editing any file under node_modules
- Preserve: phaser ~3.90.0 pin in package.json and package-lock.json
- Preserve: Existing frontend tests and source


## Technical constraints
- Do not edit vendored files; remove them from the index only, leaving files on disk


## Definition of done
- Both requirements are met and their unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · node_modules is ignored at any depth and removed from the git index
nodes.body:
Context: .gitignore has game/node_modules/ but dependencies live in game/frontend/node_modules, so they are tracked. Desired behavior: .gitignore contains a pattern matching node_modules directories at any depth and the tracked node_modules files are removed from the index with git rm --cached. Expected result: no vendored Phaser file can show as modified. Why: the intent forbids tracked node_modules changes.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given .gitignore, when its lines are read, then a line node_modules/ is present
- Given the index after the change, when git ls-files is filtered for node_modules, then the list is empty


## Scope
- In scope: .gitignore
- In scope: git index untracking
- Out of scope: Deleting node_modules from disk
- Preserve: Existing .devion ignore rules


## Technical constraints
- Keep existing .gitignore lines


## Definition of done
- Ignore rule present and index clean of node_modules


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · A pure guard helper reports tracked node_modules paths
nodes.body:
Context: nothing prevents node_modules from being re-tracked. Desired behavior: a pure function trackedNodeModulesPaths(paths) returns every path having a node_modules segment, usable on git ls-files output. Expected result: a guard can fail when vendored files are tracked. Why: prevents regressions of this intent.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given paths including game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/scripts/tsgen/src/Parser.ts and game/frontend/src/App.tsx, when the helper runs, then only the first is returned
- Given a list with no node_modules segment, when the helper runs, then an empty array is returned


## Scope
- In scope: new helper module in game/frontend/tools
- Out of scope: Running git inside the helper
- Preserve: package.json scripts


## Technical constraints
- Pure function, no filesystem or git access


## Definition of done
- Helper exported and unit tested


## Clarifying questions
- None
